svg.aria-label: I RARELY SEE THE MORNING — I'm a night owl: 889 commits in 365 days, most awake 01:00–04:00, busiest on Sundays. This week: Go 61.8%, TypeScript 16.3%, Vue 8.4%, Python 7.7%, JavaScript 3.9%. This year: Python 24.8%, Go 23.8%, Swift 14.6%, TypeScript 11.7%, Vue 8.5%.

g.text: 889 commits in 365 days · most awake 01:00–04:00 · busiest on Sundays

text.font-family: NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif

g.text: 过去一年，我提交了 889 次，大多在天黑以后。
889 commits in 365 days — most of them after dark (63%).

text.font-family: NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif

g.text: 这七天，我改动了 77,499 行代码。
In seven days, I changed 77,499 lines of code.

text.font-family: NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif
NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif

g.text: 这一年，我说得最多的是 Python。
This year, I spoke Python the most.

text.font-family: NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif
NS,CG,'Noto Serif SC','Source Han Serif SC','Songti SC',STSong,SimSun,serif

g.text: 但每个深夜，都有一束光。
But every night, there is a light.
